interpretation: Checked means named executable evidence exists, not exhaustive proof. Partial and planned entries remain explicit work. Performance targets are provisional until calibrated on a controlled runner.

entries.statement: Rejected authentication or authorization never invokes the protected handler.
entries.scope: Configured Require dependencies, registered routes and inherited mount/static policy; credential readers alone do not validate token authority.
entries.next: Add mount/static mutations and application-level token-validator fixtures.

entries.statement: Invalid bound input never invokes the handler or its injected providers.
entries.scope: Binding precedes handler dependency resolution; Require dependencies can run earlier by design.
entries.next: Generate cross-products of body, parameter, and authorization failures.

entries.statement: Successful provider resolution is memoized by provider ID within a request and isolated across requests.
entries.scope: Sequential dependency resolution per request. Does not promise concurrent use of request-local dependency APIs from user goroutines.
entries.next: Keep memoization fault injection mandatory.

entries.statement: Every successfully acquired provider resource closes once in reverse acquisition order on every terminal path.
entries.scope: Per provider acquisition after background work: success, handler error/panic, cancellation, partial acquisition and callback panics covered. Remaining closers are attempted before rethrowing the first closer panic. Excludes blocking callbacks, Goexit and process termination; aliased resources across providers need an ownership policy.
entries.next: Test write failure, disconnect and multipart temporary-file removal; define aliased-resource ownership.

entries.statement: One request cannot replace another request's state, override result, or security context.
entries.scope: Concurrent serving with configuration completed beforehand; process-global provider registration still exists.
entries.next: Design explicit app-scoped registries without breaking shared provider handles.

entries.statement: Consumed authorization codes and refresh tokens cannot be consumed again, even by competing requests.
entries.scope: Single in-memory OAuth server instance; process restart invalidates stored tokens.
entries.next: Extend barrier tests through complete public token endpoints.

entries.statement: Expired credentials fail at the exact expiry boundary and clients cannot consume another client's stored credentials.
entries.scope: Configured server clock and in-memory code/refresh stores; no distributed clock guarantee.
entries.next: Add clock discontinuity policy and injected-clock concurrency cases.

entries.statement: Refresh cannot expand granted scopes; post-consumption failure does not resurrect the old token.
entries.scope: Current burn-on-failure behavior, including scope rejection and replacement-capacity failure.
entries.next: Decide whether atomic replacement is a future API guarantee; model it before changing behavior.

entries.statement: Framework-enforced request body and OAuth-store limits cannot be exceeded by supported input paths.
entries.scope: Positive configured limits; framework readers, including chunked requests; not user allocations or arbitrary mounted-handler behavior.
entries.next: Add end-to-end memory plateau tests at sustained capacity.

entries.statement: Tampering with signed session/access-token contents does not authenticate an attacker.
entries.scope: Configured signing keys, documented HMAC format, supported parser inputs; assumes cryptographic primitives and key secrecy.
entries.next: Independent token vectors and key-rotation conformance suite.

entries.statement: CSRF and origin policy reject disallowed unsafe requests and WebSocket upgrades before protected work.
entries.scope: Configured session/CSRF/origin settings and documented exemptions.
entries.next: Add public browser integration tests for cookie and redirect behavior.

entries.statement: Malformed untrusted input yields a bounded documented failure rather than a framework panic or uncontrolled resource growth.
entries.scope: JSON, multipart and access-token fuzz targets plus existing frame properties; user callbacks may panic.
entries.next: Add credential/cookie/native WebSocket fuzz targets and explicit CPU/memory adversarial budgets.

entries.statement: Serving does not race or leak request-owned goroutines, resources, or mutable state.
entries.scope: Race detector covers exercised paths with frozen-by-convention configuration; no blanket leak proof.
entries.next: Add deterministic disconnect/leak tests and concurrent configuration rejection or explicit freeze API.

entries.statement: The supported OpenAPI schema subset and runtime wire behavior agree.
entries.scope: Independent fixture validation and selected input/response boundaries. Missing non-pointer properties, defaults, unknown fields, and custom validators need explicit parity rules.
entries.next: Define input/output schema modes and close required-property discrepancies before claiming schema equivalence.

entries.statement: Parameter sources, precedence and validation boundaries are deterministic.
entries.scope: Declared query/path/header/cookie/body/form rules; unrelated inputs do not replace tagged values.
entries.next: Broaden metamorphic cases for irrelevant headers and query ordering.

entries.statement: HTTP status, HEAD behavior, structured errors and sensitive error hiding follow documented contracts.
entries.scope: Framework-generated responses; raw handlers control their own responses.
entries.next: Independent HTTP behavior comparison and failing-writer scenarios.

entries.statement: Streaming, cancellation and lifecycle transitions terminate with documented ownership and cleanup.
entries.scope: Existing stream/start/stop coverage plus canceled-request cleanup; graceful-shutdown and disconnected-client resource bounds need strengthening.
entries.next: Barrier-driven shutdown with active streams and stalled clients; specify deadlines.

entries.statement: Dependency cycles and unsupported recursive input definitions fail during registration rather than during live request processing.
entries.scope: Current registration validation; not a universal configuration verifier.
entries.next: Expand preflight validation to ambiguous registries, schema collisions and post-start mutation.

entries.statement: Protocol claims are backed by external conformance suites with published exceptions.
entries.scope: OpenAPI fixture gate exists; full OAuth and Autobahn WebSocket conformance is not yet established.
entries.next: Integrate Autobahn client/server cases and independent OAuth negative vectors.

entries.statement: Every critical invariant has a test oracle that detects a deliberate violation.
entries.scope: Eight curated mutations and one TLC negative control, not exhaustive mutation coverage.
entries.next: Add at least one valid mutation for every P0 invariant; report survivors individually.

entries.statement: Query parsing work is shared across fields in one binding.
entries.scope: Six scalar query fields; single binding, not cross-provider caching.
entries.target: At most 32 allocations per bind on supported Go versions; observed post-change 28 versus 68 before.
entries.next: Benchmark 1/6/24-field scaling without weakening input semantics.

entries.statement: Hot-path CPU and allocations do not regress unnoticed on representative workloads.
entries.scope: JSON, validated input, query, authorization, error paths, serialization, nested dependencies, multipart and signed sessions; stream/CSRF workload coverage pending.
entries.target: Provisional: investigate >5% median ns/op or >10% B/op regression across at least 10 paired samples on a controlled runner; added allocations require explanation.
entries.next: Dedicated runner plus stream/CSRF benchmark matrix.

entries.statement: Tail latency is reported against offered load, including overload and scheduling delay.
entries.scope: Bounded open-loop generator; all completed requests include failed responses; drops reported separately.
entries.target: Provisional: no more than 10% p99 regression at the same reference offered load, with zero drops and errors; calibrate baseline first.
entries.next: Run client on a separate host and establish 25/50/75/100/125% saturation curves.

entries.statement: Resource use reaches a stable plateau under sustained bounded traffic and returns after overload.
entries.scope: Framework-owned memory/goroutines; application-owned state measured separately.
entries.target: Provisional: after warmup, post-GC heap slope <=1 MiB/min over 30 minutes at fixed load; goroutine count returns to baseline plus documented idle connections within 30 seconds.
entries.next: Instrument server metrics, run soak/disconnect tests, calibrate limits per workload.

entries.statement: Streaming memory is bounded by concurrency and buffer sizes, not total response length.
entries.scope: Framework stream/SSE paths with cooperative writers and cancellation.
entries.target: Provisional: increasing streamed bytes 100x at fixed concurrency must not increase retained post-GC heap by >10% or 1 MiB, whichever is larger.
entries.next: Slow-reader, failed-writer, cancellation and large-stream profile fixtures.

entries.statement: Invalid and unauthenticated traffic cannot make valid traffic unboundedly expensive.
entries.scope: Measured mixed workloads under configured limits, not a universal denial-of-service guarantee.
entries.target: Provisional: publish p99 and successful-throughput change for 0/10/50/90% rejected traffic at identical offered load and payload sizes.
entries.next: Mixed-method load matrix and invalid-body CPU profiles.

entries.statement: Comparative speed claims name equivalent work, runtime topology, resource limits and uncertainty.
entries.scope: net/http is a minimal baseline; FastAPI fixture has response validation and different semantics. No blanket faster claim.
entries.target: Publish versions, source hashes, raw repeats and semantic differences with every comparison.
entries.next: Add Huma comparison, separate-client runs, repeated samples and confidence intervals.

entries.statement: Registration, startup and schema generation scale predictably with application size.
entries.scope: Route count, dependency depth/fanout and schema count are separate dimensions.
entries.target: Measure 10/100/1000 routes and depth 1/5/20; explain superlinear growth before selecting numerical budgets.
entries.next: Add startup and schema-size scaling benchmarks.

entries.statement: A new user can implement and test a validated authenticated endpoint without learning hidden framework behavior.
entries.scope: Observed usability tasks with fresh users; concise source examples are not usability evidence.
entries.target: Provisional: 4/5 participants complete within 15 minutes; record errors, documentation lookups and assistance.
entries.next: Run the protocol in docs/usability.md with consenting participants.

entries.statement: A release's public guarantees are traceable to versioned, reproducible evidence and explicit gaps.
entries.scope: Local evidence tooling and CI configuration exist; hosted CI/release execution is separate evidence.
entries.next: Publish CI artifacts per tagged release and review invariant status before release.

entries.statement: Applications have a documented configuration/serving boundary and useful fail-fast errors.
entries.scope: Configure routes, providers and overrides before concurrent serving; no enforced freeze API today.
entries.next: Design explicit build/freeze lifecycle and app-local registry migration.
